name: polishing-flourish-removes-sheen-from-your-units
notes: Polishing Flourish: 'Remove all sheen counters from units you control' used to never run. Your Dungeon Guide loses its sheen; the opposing Dungeon Guide keeps its own.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Polishing Flourish's effect was generated as an $enterAbilities entry, but it is an Action that never enters the field, so activating it only paid its cost and sent it to the graveyard: the effect never ran. Fix: OnCardActivated() runs an Action's enter ability as its resolution effect when the card has no activation ability of its own.
